_source: CBP ruling N343777 (27 Nov 2024), scenario 1: Chinese polyester fabrics cut to shape, sewn and embroidered in China, then stuffed, sewn closed and finished in Vietnam: CBP held China. In scenario 2 of the same ruling the cutting and sewing are done in Vietnam. In the D660 selection pool (substantial transformation, dated before 2026, in no development, held-out or tune-check split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Plush dinosaur toy
product.description: A 22-inch plush dinosaur with a polyester knit body and a faux fur dorsal fin, filled with fibre and a bag of plastic pellets.
